fns.desc: dpp_pkex_finish() leaks the entire pkex object (x/y crypto keys, code, identifier, z, wpabufs) when dpp_bootstrap_key_hash(bi) fails: that branch frees only bi and returns NULL without calling dpp_pkex_free(pkex), unlike the success path 3 lines below. No caller (dpp_hostapd.c:2359,2392; dpp_supplicant.c:3352) frees pkex on the !bi return either.
pkex->enc_key = wpabuf_alloc_copy(Mx, 2*curve->prime_len) is never NULL-checked (unlike every other allocation in this file); low-confidence, deferred-use only.
